asset.name: CalendarView
asset.description: The day, week, month, agenda, or resource calendar with virtualization, selection, drag and resize editing, timezone handling, responsive modes, and overlap layout.

requires.reason: Date grid, localization, and keyboard traversal are shared.
Event resizing composes the shared primitive.

rationale: Overlap layout is the hard part and the reason this cannot be a thin wrapper: correctly packing concurrent events into columns without hiding any is a real algorithm, and getting it wrong silently loses appointments.
